info.title: edsdcf-check - validate CiA 306 EDS/DCF files
info.description: edsdcf-check: command-line validator for CiA 306 EDS and DCF files, built on the EdsDcfNet rule catalog.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to a file instead of stdout.

options.name: --severity
options.description: Set a rule to error, warning or none (repeatable).

options.name: --config
options.description: JSON file with severity overrides and path globs.

options.name: --list-rules
options.description: Print every rule with its default severity.

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: Exit with code 1 when warnings are found.

options.name: --no-library
options.description: Skip the EdsDcfNet reader/model validation pass.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes: 0 = valid, 1 = errors found, 2 = usage or I/O problem.
An unreadable file or directory is reported and skipped; the rest is still checked.
Exit code 2 is also used when every given file is skipped (not .eds/.dcf).
